bio.text: Joe Courtney was elected in 2006 to represent Connecticut's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and serves on the Armed Services Committee.
From 1987 to 1994 he represented Vernon in the Connecticut General Assembly.
He graduated from Tufts University in 1975 and earned a law degree from the University of Connecticut School of Law in 1978, and lives in Vernon.
